def.label: coaxial machine gun
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.2's cycle (Q-49-3): a burst of ten every 5,000 ms, at the floor every mount a player or a mind fires is held to, so the shipped content proves the floor is reachable and not merely asserted. A 600-round belt (Q-49-22) is sixty bursts, five minutes of fire. 1.2 km is inside visual detection at 60 cells (600 m) plus signature, so the coaxial gun is for a contact already classified.
